responsibility: Declares the privacy-diagnostic visitor for the Rust HIR. The PrivacyReporter interface ties together Analysis::Mappings, the resolver, and TypeCheckContext, and lists the expression/item/statement visit hooks plus helper routines for checking referenced items and explicit types, defining the public structure of the pass that reports privacy violations after visibility has already been resolved.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration side of the privacy reporter: unlike rust-privacy-reporter.cc, it defines the visitor class shape, constructor, helper signatures, and visit hooks without implementing the traversal or diagnostic decisions.
